mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_compiled_artifact ( tenant_id, artifact_id, definition_id, definition_version, type_name, abi, payload, checksum, source_digest, signature_key_id, signature_value, metadata_json, compiled_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{artifactId}, #{definitionId}, #{definitionVersion}, #{typeName}, #{abi}, #{payload}, #{checksum}, #{sourceDigest}, #{signatureKeyId}, #{signatureValue}, #{metadataJson}, #{compiledAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, artifact_id AS artifactId, definition_id AS definitionId, definition_version AS definitionVersion, type_name AS typeName, abi, payload, checksum, source_digest AS sourceDigest, signature_key_id AS signatureKeyId, signature_value AS signatureValue, metadata_json AS metadataJson, compiled_at AS compiledAt FROM mk_compiled_artifact WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND artifact_id = #{artifactId}
